The Story Of Rebel
Full Fat. No Sugar. All Rebel.

Rebel started because low carb ice cream kept tasting like a compromise. Chalky, icy, skimmed down. So we made the real thing: full fat dairy, no sugar added, and the texture ice cream is supposed to have.

WHY WE MADE REBEL

Rebel is ice cream built for keto and low carb living: full fat dairy, no sugar added, and real ice cream texture. We make pints and stick bars that eat like the ice cream you grew up on, with a fraction of the carbs, so dessert fits the way you actually live.
